items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Guys like Richard Davis came out from under Mister Elgar. [INTERVIEWEE] Is that right? ... [INTERVIEWER] Richard Davis' folks are from New Orleans, too, you know. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, I heard that.

ctx.x: But the people who went through that disappointment, like you said, Charles Elgar and them people, they... I guess they had seen a lot. And he was a high-class man.

Yeah, he was a high-class man. Yeah, he did... Mister Elgar did a great deal for Chicago, the Black musicians of Chicago until he died. He almost lived... He quite a life -- past ninety. And he got involved with the union, with those bands, with the union trust fund. And he was always for helping young ones, a couple of young cello players... Guys like Richard Davis came out from under Mister Elgar.
